Crimson Isle.how: Teleport to the Scarlet Forest Observation Site Kibelisk and go north to the Windstream, where Takis the treasure hunter stands. Jump in: it carries you over the sea to the Crimson Isle Outpost. Register the Crimson Isle Outpost Kibelisk when you land; after that you can teleport straight there.

Eternal Isle.how: Teleport to the Astin Mercenaries Base Kibelisk. The Windstream is about 400 m away, at the cliff in south-western Tolbas Forest where Ahtan the Creion researcher stands. Jump in: it carries you to the island. You can also get there from the Sky Island west of Aullaeu Village. Enemies here are level 49 to 51.
Eternal Isle.leave: There is no Kibelisk on Eternal Isle, so bring a teleport scroll to leave.

Spirit Isle.how: Teleport to the Basfelt Waterfall Kibelisk and go north to the Windstream, where Milo the treasure hunter stands. Jump in: it carries you over the sea to the island. Register the Guide's Dwelling Kibelisk when you land; after that you can teleport straight there.

Immortal Isle.how: Teleport to the Wave-Swept Cliff Kibelisk and jump into the blue Windstream there: it carries you over the sea to the island. Enemies here are level 49 to 51.
Immortal Isle.leave: There is no Kibelisk on Immortal Isle, so bring a teleport scroll to leave.
